name: Zhan yu Zhi Chui Ying Xia ~ Flowering Across the Hakugyokurou
original_name: 绽于枝垂樱下~Flowering Across the Hakugyokurou
source:
I woke up from the gap just like before.
...
Why do I dreamt about things at that time?
...
In this case, I haven't been to Hakugyokurou for a while.
...
I drunk some tea to make myself awake.
...
It's still a normal day and I didn't do anything.
...
In this case, maybe I should visit Hakugyokurou.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1063190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我像之前一样从间隙中醒来。
…
为什么我会梦到当时的事情？
…
这么说来，我已经有一段时间没有去过白玉楼了。
…
我喝了点茶让自己清醒一下。
…
这仍然是正常的一天，我什么也没做。
…
既然如此，也许我应该去白玉楼看看。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1063190/]Steam[/url]]
